name: Shatter Flow
summary:
Drive into an unreal state of Flow in a completely different dimension, keep moving forward, and synchronize yourself with the music and the flow as you shatter everything in your path! 
Shatter Flow requires intense focus and concentration, along with timing, to not only travel as far as you can but also shatter everything coming your way.

👉 Shatter every piece of glass coming your way while in flow by using your metal ball blasters.
